correctness.rationale: Conditional Brownian area has variance 2DL^3/3; the Pareto cycle reward characteristic function has an exactly computable small-frequency singularity. Stable and critical Gaussian limit laws follow from iid reward functional limits plus a renewal-count deterministic time change. The equilibrium boundary fragments are tight and negligible. Separately, the renewal age/residual identity gives the exact stationary covariance and variance integrals; at alpha=3 their leading coefficient differs by a factor three from the Gaussian weak-limit coefficient. 106 standalone deterministic comparisons passed, but do not replace infinite-time proofs.

value.rationale: Time-averaged signed position is a natural Brownian transport observable. The exact Pareto exponent-three boundary, symmetric stable index and scale, stationary memory law and factor-three failure of critical Gaussian second-moment convergence quantify the physically important distinction between typical reset-mediated transport and rare long excursions. The result does not rely on arbitrary finite cutoffs for its novelty: cutoff one simply fixes units.
